Name: Juniisia's Portraits - Content Patcher
Author: Juniisia
Description:
Adds little changes to the original characters' portraits to make them appear softer. For people who want the SV characters to look just a little different, but have the same vibes as the original versions. :)
---
I didn't change all the characters' looks, some of them I just blended a little bit to match my softer style. But some characters are changed to the point of being unrecognizable - like Emily. All of the portraits are in the images!
---
The mod now has a CONFIG file, in which you can pick what portraits and sprites do you want to use, and which ones you prefer not to! (thanks for the great idea, @bezajel)
-------------------------------
Credits for Poltergeister & Jazzybee's Stardew portrait maker that was used for the Maru portraits!

Downloads.Description: This file includes the portraits, sprites, as well as a config file!
